start.text: Pip is a little dog. Pip has a red ball. One day, the ball rolls away! Where did it go?

park.text: Pip runs to the park. A cat sits on a bench. "Did you see my ball?" says Pip. "Yes," says the cat. "It went up the hill."

pond.text: Pip runs to the pond. A duck swims by. Quack! "I see a red ball," says the duck. "It is up on the hill."

hill.text: Pip runs up the hill. There is the red ball! A goat kept it safe. Pip and the goat play catch. The End.

home.text: Pip goes home. He is sad. But Mom has a surprise. The red ball was under the bed! The End.
